entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Could you please provide your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's under sarah.vip@email.com. The order for the cycling shoes.
Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here. Before we proceed, could you tell me a bit more about the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference issue?
They're just not good. They give me terrible blisters every time I ride, no matter how I adjust the cleats.
I'm very sorry to hear that the shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the purchase date for you. One moment.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I see the shoes were delivered 61 days ago. Since these are a standard item, they fall well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.

Of course. And Sarah, I also see that you're one of our VIP members. To thank you for your loyalty and apologize for the trouble with the shoes, I've gone ahead and added a $20 credit to your account for a future purchase. I've just initiated the return, and the shipping label is on its way to your email right now.
Okay. I guess that's something. So I just print the label?

That's correct. Just print the label, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the cycling shoes, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can provide you with a better experience next time. Have a good day.
